extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent discussed Medicare Advantage plans with the customer, who prioritized the lowest premium. The agent collected a Scope of Appointment and scheduled a plan review for 2 days later.
composition.coaching_note: Tamika, you mentioned that the Mutual of Omaha plan has a $35 monthly premium, but you didn't explicitly state that this is a competitive rate. Consider adding more context to help the customer understand the value of the plan.
